text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the owner of 309 Bessborough Drive to maintain an existing tempered glass pool enclosure fence in the rear yard. The existing tempered glass fence does not meet the requirements specified in City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences.

North York Community Council: 1. Granted the exemption to the owners of 309 Bessborough Drive to have the existing tempered glass pool enclosure fence in the rear yard to be maintained in the same condition without alteration. At such time as replacement of the fence is required that the replacement fence will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, Fences, or its successor by-law.
